name: Challenges
overview: Scripture reveals that challenges are an inevitable part of the Christian life, yet believers are called to trust wholly in the LORD rather than their own understanding. God promises His presence and help, encouraging us not to fear as He holds our hand through difficulties. Through prayer and thanksgiving, we are to bring our concerns to God, finding strength in Christ who empowers us to overcome hardships. Ultimately, peace is found in Jesus, who has already overcome the world despite the tribulations we face.
